summary: Implement live icon, real filtered BLE search, permission-correct district/current-fix/reverse-geocoder orchestration, skiing GNSS processing/history/cursors, and RTT listener lifecycle. All 22 assigned runtime requirements remain open until new-package acceptance.

requirements_review.finding: No fusion-fence implementation/export was found. Existing GNSS and beacon fences are separate paths and do not implement the SDK fusion type/scene request contract.
evidence: backend-excerpts.json: icon producer audit where applicable
requirements_review.next_required: Implement real fused GNSS/cellular/Wi-Fi/Bluetooth fence backend, capability query and IPC/bindings; validate supported and unsupported combinations, add/remove ownership, transitions and permissions.

requirements_review.finding: Promise-only optional/undefined request now starts an owned authorized one-shot location request, uses its permitted recent cache or real fix, always stops a started request, queries the real reverse-geocoder/cache within one deadline, and rechecks fine/approximate/firstToken/current-account/switch access before publishing district fields. SDK area-query errors use 3301500.
requirements_review.next_required: Generate new IDL68/71, compile complete native/service/NAPI TUs, provide actual GNSS and configured geocoder ability over externally challenged data using documented peer ABI; validate new-package cache/current-fix/locale/deadline/permission/user/stop behavior.

requirements_review.finding: NAPI and Taihe now call a service-side system-permission checked IPC query. Current-account GNSS/network/fused requests must have active privacy-use state, valid lifetime, permission and switch state; frozen, passive-only and other-account requests are excluded. No HD provider is present, so HD status is not inferred. Fine-only callers now use actual ACCESS_LOCATION PrivacyKit start/stop accounting; approximate callers retain approximate accounting. Query snapshots under request/permission locks, then checks permissions/accounts/freeze/RDB after releasing them.
evidence: backend-excerpts.json: icon producer audit where applicable
requirements_review.next_required: Generate/compile the updated IDL and complete location TUs, then new packaged normal/system-caller query, start/stop/freeze/user/switch/permission boundaries. An actual HD provider/state source is still required for HD status.

requirements_review.finding: SKIING travels through a new explicit IPC sports argument while legacy RequestConfig wire remains unchanged. SPORT requests use fine PrivacyKit state and real GNSS reports; accuracy/time-driven processing produces geometry, altitude, speed and direction. UID/token/firstToken history has 24h monotonic retention and incremental cursors with source/mock/out-of-order/privacy/lifecycle checks.
requirements_review.next_required: Generate IDL69/70, rebuild RequestConfig consumers and complete listed TUs, then new-package GNSS challenge tracks with SPORT-only mode, ordinary/system fine permissions, background/revoke/switch, multiple owners/delegation, stop/late samples, retention and cursor boundaries. Assess processing behavior on actual virtual peripheral input.
